Advanced Fiber Resources.why: supplies fiber array units, TFLN modulators and passive components into data-center optical modules; optical communication device revenue +115.04% on AI data-center demand
Advanced Fiber Resources.evidence: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026): fiber arrays (DR4 / DR8 / MT-FAU) and TFLN modulators for data centers; customers include Cisco, Ciena, Lumentum, Broadcom, Nokia, Fabrinet, Fujikura and Innolight

players.product: fiber array units (DR4 / DR8 / MT-FAU, PM fiber arrays for CPO), thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) modulators and chips, isolators, circulators and WDM modules for data-center optical modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue rose 72.91% to RMB 1,031,662,205.86 and net profit attributable to shareholders rose 186.09% to RMB 148,395,975.24, as accelerating global AI computing infrastructure investment and data-center construction kept lifting demand for high-speed optical modules and components, plus new products and new customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical communication devices revenue rose 115.04% to RMB 601,822,297.41 (gross margin 39.36%); fiber laser devices revenue rose 23.94% to RMB 378,780,271.21; overseas sales were 57.02% of revenue.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical communication devices: H1 2026 capacity 6,200,000 units, output 6,167,948 units and sales 6,060,596 units, versus capacity 3,100,000 units a year earlier; output rose 102.42% and sales 98.96%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lithium niobate modulators: sampling to leading domestic and overseas customers increased this year with continued small-batch shipments, and the company is developing next-generation data-center products with end and module customers; some bulk lithium niobate modulators ship in volume and some new thin-film modulator products have received small-batch orders from leading customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company has the capability for 96GBaud and 130GBaud TFLN coherent driver modulators for 800Gbps-plus coherent links and for 800 / 1600 / 3200Gbps non-coherent TFLN modulator chips and devices; new products include new FAUs and high-performance circulators for AI data centers, micro-optic integrated devices for CPO / NPO, and M x N high-precision fiber arrays for OCS equipment and subsea networks.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Thailand base: volume production of polarisation-maintaining fiber devices and pigtails; its high-precision multichannel FAU has passed a major customer's qualified supplier list and capacity is being expanded.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Named optical communication customers: Cisco, Ciena, Finisar, Lumentum, Broadcom, Nokia, Fabrinet, Fujikura and Innolight; laser customers include Trumpf, Coherent, Spectra-Physics and leading Chinese fiber-laser makers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Fiber Resources half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: A major asset restructuring started in July 2025 to buy 99.97% of Suzhou Anjiexun Optoelectronic Technology was not yet completed at the end of the period.
